trial_court: Family Court, Ahmedabad (CRIMINAL Misc. Application No.1887/2003)
facts_of_case: Petitioner's wife and minor daughter challenged an order dated 31.1.2009 passed by the Family Court regarding maintenance under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

legal_principles.principle: Maintenance payable under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure is for a different purpose than maintenance payable under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act.
legal_principles.held: It was observed that maintenance payable under Section 24 of Hindu Marriage Act and one under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure are for different purposes.
cited_cases: Hansaben Rameshkumar Patani v. Rameshkumar Ratilal Patni & anr., (1992) 2 GLR 1404

legal_principles.principle: The income of a wife should not be deducted from her maintenance if she is serving during her stay with the husband.
legal_principles.held: The Magistrate while awarding maintenance under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, had taken into consideration the fact that wife was serving during her stay with the husband and deducted such income from her maintenance.
cited_cases: Pannaben Ramanlal Soni v. Jitendrakumar Chimanlal Soni and another, (1991) 1 GLH 616

outcome.final_order: The petitioners' claim for maintenance was allowed.

keywords: Latin maxim: Actus non facit reum nisi mens sit rea
